thread.title: Goldman Sachs Slashes iPhone Sales Forecast

author: thestreet.com
title: Goldman Sachs Slashes iPhone Sales Forecast

organizations.name: goldman sachs slashes iphone sales forecast analysts

text:
Analysts at Goldman Sachs have joined a growing chorus of analysts worried about Apple Inc.'s ( AAPL ) iPhone sales.
The firm said that it expects the Action Alerts PLUS holding to sell fewer iPhones in the first half of 2018 than it previously did. Goldman expects the company to ship 53 million units in the March quarter and 40.3 million in the June quarter.
Previously, the firm estimated the company would sell 54.7 million iPhones in the first quarter and 43.5 million in the second.
"iPhone demand expectations for March and June are already weak but we believe that early CQ1 (calendar first quarter) demand indications suggest even lower actual numbers than consensus is modeling," Goldman said in the note.
For the fiscal year, which ends Sept. 30, 2018, the firm expects Apple to sell 217.3 million units, a 2.5% decrease from its previous forecast.
Goldman also noted that its expectations for the average selling price of Apple products is now 2% below market consensus for the June quarter.
